metadata.question: Did burn scars near San Jose, California on August 26, 2020 expand in comparison to the same region in June?

data.raw_code: The user wants to know if burn scars near San Jose, California expanded between June 2020 and August 26, 2020. For burn scar analysis, I should: 1. Use Landsat 8 or Sentinel-2 data (both good for vegetation/burn analysis) 2. Calculate NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) which is excellent for detecting burn scars 3. NBR = (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR) 4. Lower NBR values indicate burn scars 5. Compare the burned area between the two time periods Strategy: - Location: San Jose, California area - Time periods: June 2020 and August 26, 2020 - Use Landsat 8 surface reflectance - Calculate NBR for both periods - Threshold NBR to identify burned areas - Compare burned pixel counts Data quality considerations: - Check if collections have images - Check if valid pixels exist after cloud masking - Validate the results are reasonable ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const sanJose = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.8863, 37.3382]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around San Jose // Time periods const june2020 = ee.DateRange('2020-06-01', '2020-06-30'); const august2020 = ee.DateRange('2020-08-20', '2020-09-02'); // Window around Aug 26 // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 8 Surface Reflectance let juneCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(sanJose) .filterDate(june2020) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let augustCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(sanJose) .filterDate(august2020) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); // Check collection sizes const juneSize = juneCol.size().getInfo(); const augustSize = augustCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June 2020 Images: ${juneSize}, August 2020 Images: ${augustSize}`); if (juneSize === 0 || augustSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get median composites and calculate NBR function calculateNBR(image) { // Apply scaling factors const opticalBands = image.select('SR_B.').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const nir = opticalBands.select('SR_B5'); const swir = opticalBands.select('SR_B7'); const nbr = nir.subtract(swir).divide(nir.add(swir)).rename('NBR'); return image.addBands(nbr); } const juneMedian = calculateNBR(juneCol.median()); const augustMedian = calculateNBR(augustCol.median()); // 4. Burn scar detection - NBR < 0.1 indicates burn scars const burnThreshold = 0.1; const juneBurned = juneMedian.select('NBR').lt(burnThreshold); const augustBurned = augustMedian.select('NBR').lt(burnThreshold); // Count burned pixels const juneCount = juneBurned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sanJose, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const augustCount = augustBurned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sanJose, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); console.log(`June burned pixels: ${Math.round(juneCount)}`); console.log(`August burned pixels: ${Math.round(augustCount)}`); // Validation checks if (juneCount === 0 || augustCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (juneCount === null || augustCount === null || isNaN(juneCount) || isNaN(augustCount) || juneCount < 0 || augustCount < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Final comparison - did burn scars expand? const expansion = ((augustCount - juneCount) / juneCount) * 100; console.log(`Burn scar expansion: ${expansion.toFixed(1)}%`); // Consider expansion if >10% increase if (expansion > 10) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
